title: Smart Cities
summary: Traffic optimisation, anomaly detection and crowd analytics for safer, smarter urban environments.
body: Cities generate huge amounts of data from cameras, sensors and connected infrastructure. We help municipalities and operators turn that data into real-time insight — improving mobility, safety and the quality of public services while respecting citizens’ privacy.

use_cases.title: Traffic optimisation
use_cases.text: Vehicle counting, classification and flow analysis to improve signal timing and planning.

use_cases.title: Crowd analytics
use_cases.text: Anonymous occupancy and flow metrics for public spaces, events and transport hubs.

use_cases.title: Anomaly detection
use_cases.text: Real-time alerts for incidents, obstructions and unusual activity.

use_cases.title: Environmental monitoring
use_cases.text: IoT sensors for air quality, noise and energy use across the city.

seo.title: Smart City Solutions | Traffic & Crowd Analytics
seo.description: AI and computer-vision solutions for smart cities: traffic optimisation, crowd analytics, anomaly detection and IoT environmental monitoring.

title: Defence & Security
summary: Situational awareness, perimeter surveillance and threat detection through multi-modal AI vision systems.
body: Security and defence organisations need to detect threats early, with fewer false alarms, in environments where connectivity and time are limited. We combine sensors, AI and resilient software to give operators a clear, shared picture.

use_cases.title: Perimeter surveillance
use_cases.text: AI-assisted detection of intrusions across camera, radar and sensor networks.

use_cases.title: Situational awareness
use_cases.text: Geospatial operational pictures that combine sensor feeds, events and assets.

use_cases.title: Threat detection
use_cases.text: Multi-modal analysis to identify and classify objects of interest.

use_cases.title: Research & development
use_cases.text: Prototyping and evaluation of new sensing and AI capabilities.

seo.title: Defence & Security Industry Solutions
seo.description: Situational awareness, perimeter surveillance and multi-modal threat detection for defence and security organisations.

use_cases.title: Asset monitoring

use_cases.title: Predictive maintenance

use_cases.title: Worker safety
